description_en: Queries the remaining real-time log delivery quota for a specified site and business type
description_zh: 查询指定站点与业务类型的实时日志投递剩余配额
name: GetSiteLogDeliveryQuota

parameters.help_en:
The type of real-time logs. Valid values:
dcdn_log_access_l1 (default): access logs.
dcdn_log_er: edge function logs.
dcdn_log_waf: security protection logs.
dcdn_log_ipa: Layer 4 acceleration logs
parameters.help_zh:
实时日志类型，取值：
dcdn_log_access_l1（默认值）：访问日志。
dcdn_log_er：边缘函数日志。
dcdn_log_waf：安全防护日志。
dcdn_log_ipa：四层加速日志
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

schema.description_en: The data structure returned upon a successful response
schema.description_zh: 响应成功时返回的数据结构
